notes.title: 2024 Troll Level

notes.title: New Level Added!
notes.notes:
Added a new level that might bring out some nostalgia...

Fixed Steam cloud saves.

Fixed Steam achievements for bosses in the first system.

notes.title: Level Select Navigation
notes.notes: Navigating levels uses the right and left arrow keys to move between numbered levels, and down can be used to move to optional levels. This prevents navigation from stopping at a fork in the road.

notes.title: Fullscreen Preference
notes.notes: Fullscreen toggle is now saved in save data
